messages:
Alex: FYI promo for v2026.03.1 is blocked in the 18:00 UTC window. Package verify passed but the runtime extract fails with manifest truncated on a subset of runners. DeployBot stopped the promotion. Anyone seen this pattern before?
Lina: saw similar once when registry signed-layer uploads got interrupted. error on runner: "OCI manifest truncated while reading layer 4/7". Repro on eu-central/windows-2022 only.
DeployBot: Automated Alert  Promotion Halted 
  action: auto-hold
  promo-id: 4591
  reason: manifest_truncation
  affected-runners: eu-central-5, eu-central-7
QA-bot: quick smoke matrix: previous tag v2026.03.0 passes basic smoke on same runners. Suggest pinning to previous image if we need the window.
Raj: can we do a fast manual reupload of the same build artifact from the builder host? That avoids rebuilding but may be unsafe if the builders local file is partial. We need to ensure layer checksums match.
Lina: I pulled the artifact blob from the builder host and the layer blob size differs from registry by ~64KB. registry shows complete size but runner read hits EOF. suspect CDN/origin reassembly bug or multipart commit race. infra-bot any ingress/edge reports?
infra-bot: Observability: CDN origin returned 206 partial-range responses during 1745601100-1745601180. 4 nodes reported reassembly retries. Suggest reverify registry storage for object completeness.
Alex: options: 1) manual-promote previous tag and continue (fast, lowest risk) 2) reupload exact blobs from builder (medium risk, quick) 3) rebuild+upload new artifact (safe, may miss change window) 4) abort window. I'm leaning to pin-old + schedule rebuild. Thoughts?
Raj: +1 pin-old. If we pin we must add a release-note entry: "Canary pinned to v2026.03.0 due to artifact manifest truncation on eu-central runners; rebuild and full reverify scheduled." Also open a ticket to track CDN partial-range regression.
Lina: I'll prepare the manual-promote command for DeployBot and attach the blob-diff logs. Also will run a local `skopeo inspect --raw` and `sha256sum` on each layer to confirm.
DeployBot: Manual promote PR created: PR-821. Promo marked: blocked -> manual-approve-needed. Command: `/deploybot manual-promote PR-821 lock-window 60m`
Alex: approved in the thread. Mike (release lead) please click through when you see the PR.
Raj: creating infra ticket INF-1429 for CDN partial-range; adding logs and timeline.
Lina: reupload attempt: copying blobs from builder -> registry (single-part) now. will report success/fail in ~4m.
infra-bot: Observability update: CDN partial-range errors subsided at 1745601365. No new reassembly failures in last 2 min.
QA-bot: running quick acceptance on v2026.03.0 on eu-central/windows-2022 now (will post results).
Alex: thanks. keeping change window locked for 45 more mins while Lina finishes reupload and QA finishes verification. If reupload passes we can consider unblocking the full promo path; else we'll proceed with the pinned promote.
Lina: reupload completed; registry reports blob complete. I re-checked layer shas: builder vs new-registry match. Pushed a note to PR-821.
QA-bot: acceptance: eu-central/windows-2022 smoke -> PASS. No extract errors observed.
DeployBot: Promotion action: Manual promote PR-821 executed; canary pinned to v2026.03.0 per request.
Alex: added short note to release_notes/diffs.md: "Canary held: using prior artifact due to manifest truncation on eu-central runners. Reupload/rebuild follow-up scheduled. See INF-1429."
Raj: assigned INF-1429 to infra-team for follow-up.
Alex: thanks all. We'll reopen full promo when rebuild completes and infra confirms CDN fix. :thumbsup:
